reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Skip release candidates on updates by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5507", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The flux CLI update flow keeps working but now skips release candidate versions, so updates no longer pick them up.

proposed.statement: The Flux 2.7.0 CLI now skips release candidate versions when updating (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5507).
